findings.claim: The declared-action preflight rejects ordinary data-model content when it happens to contain an action.event structure.
findings.evidence: _undeclaredAction checks value['action'] on every map and recursively traverses all value.values, including updateDataModel.value. With declaredActions enabled by agent_surface_provider.dart, a valid data value such as {"action":{"event":{"name":"business.operation"}}} therefore causes UNDECLARED_ACTION even though it declares no renderer action.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict the declared-action inspection to action properties of components in updateComponents messages rather than recursively interpreting arbitrary data-model values as component declarations.
